ResearchProjectDef.label: assimilation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rebuild a living body to the pattern of another humanlike race while keeping the mind intact. This is how the invaders turn the locals into their own blood: newbloods by consent, the remade by force. Unlocks construction of the assimilation pod in Architect > Misc. Requires Electricity research; the pod is built by a constructor, not crafted at a workbench.
